title: Knitting Circle
desc:
Audience: Adult, Older Adult

Do you like to knit or crochet? Come join our knitting circle! This knitting circle is run in partnership with Casting Off the Cold, which is a volunteer organization that collects hand knitted and crocheted blankets, hats, scarves, mitts, baby clothes and similar items to donate to charities in York Region that support people in need in our community. We have been donating annually since 2006. Our group members knit at home, and we like to meet once a month to show and collect our completed projects which are donated in the autumn. Any interested knitter or crocheter is welcome to join us. We have a Facebook page: casting off the cold, and a blog: castingoffthecold.blogspot.ca with more information and contact details. Please note: this is not a knitting class.

title: Vaughan Multicultural Festival
desc:
Visit Vaughan Types: FESTIVAL,EVTCOMNTY
Visit Vaughan Cost: Free entry and parking
Celebrate diversity, culture, and community at the Vaughan Multicultural Festival 2026 hosted by Muslim Women of Vaughan! Join us for an exciting afternoon filled with live music, cultural dance performances, family-friendly entertainment, and fun activities for all ages. Enjoy free face painting, henna, and balloon twisting for kids while connecting with people from different backgrounds and cultures across Vaughan. This community celebration promotes unity, inclusion, and cultural appreciation under the theme “One Community, Many Cultures.” Sunday, June 28, 2026 1:30 PM – 5:30 PM Chatfield District Park, 100 Lawford Road, Vaughan, ON Free Entry & Free Parking Bring your family and friends for a memorable day of celebration, entertainment, and multicultural experiences!
